title: Canon of the Fated Hour
summary: A canon on fate joined to time in which the hour to come is read, delayed, mended and in the end ordained, as the direction of the river of time is turned by the weight of fate.

title: Book of the Unbound Lot
summary: A book on fate joined to chaos in which the lot is thrown loose from every pattern, ending in a cast that no foe or friend can read.
